messages:
Lizzy: Heads up — I'm submitting my resignation. Last day April 9. Can we confirm COBRA/benefits end date, 401k rollover steps, KMS key rotation for my service accounts, and laptop handoff? Also want to do an exit interview the week before. Thanks.

Katie (People Ops): Thanks Lizzy — sorry to see you go. I'll schedule exit interview. COBRA: benefits vendor sends enrollment link within 7 days of termination; coverage effective date is last day of month by default unless you elect earlier. I'll DM details.

Aaron (Benefits): @Lizzy COBRA timeline: vendor (AcmeBenefits) sends email to your personal address. Coverage ends at 11:59pm on 4/9 unless you elect COBRA. Premiums calculated from the day after termination. I'll send the enrollment checklist.

Devon (Eng): For KMS: list of service principals you own? We need to reassign and rotate keys. Can you paste the repo/service list? e.g., `infra/ingest-svc`, `benchmarks/rl-training`

Lizzy: Ack. I'm the owner of `infra/ingest-svc` and `sandbox/lizzy-notebooks`. I'll remove personal creds tonight and add a README of runbook.

IT-Bot: Offboarding ticket OFF-4321 created, scheduled pickup for laptop on 2026-04-12. Courier: FedEx (label will be DM'd).

IT: @Lizzy please backup any personal files to your personal cloud. We will image wipe: `sudo redwood-wipe --confirm --asset-id RWD-4422`. We'll remove MDM and company certs during staging.

Security: For KMS rotation, we'll rotate customer-owned keys ONCE after deprovision and rotate access policies. Timeline: key rotation window 48h after access removal. We'll coordinate with @Devon. Also confirm any HSM/KMS grants to external vendors.

Aaron (Benefits): 401k: Vanguard rollover — you'll get distribution packet within 10 business days. Ask payroll for final contributions. DM me if you want a referral for a rollover advisor.

Katie (People Ops): Quick checklist I'm creating: 1) Exit interview scheduled (opt-in), 2) Benefits notice sent, 3) IT ticket + laptop pickup, 4) Access deprovision (github, slack, aws), 5) 401k packet, 6) final payroll. Any blockers?

Devon (Eng): We'll remove GitHub org membership on last business day 4/9 EOD. Please push any pending PRs or reassign. @Lizzy, put a list of OWNERS to transfer.

Lizzy: I'll reassign PRs today and add a short handoff doc in the infra repo. Also: I have personal API keys in `~/.config`. Will wipe them.

Katie (People Ops): Noted. I'll set deprovision kick at 4/9 5pm PT — that order includes slack, Google, Okta, AWS, GitHub. If you need earlier access for final handover, tell me.

Lizzy: Can we pause deprovision for 24 hours after last day to help a final handover? I have a critical script to copy.

Katie (People Ops): We can allow a 24h access buffer in special cases; need manager signoff. @Devon can you confirm?

Devon (Eng): Manager approves 24h buffer. We'll put a temporary elevated session with audit logs enabled. Security, please keep logs.

Security: A 24h extension is OK. We'll require 2FA re-auth and initiate session recording. Add note: No network egress for external transfers.

People-Ops-Bot: Reminder: Exit interview form: <https://go.redwood/offboard-survey>. Lizzy, please fill before 4/5.

Katie (People Ops): I'll follow up with DM about address for FedEx. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
